title: Distinctive Mark runs its own Cyclotrons, separate from the shared Anthus/Data Parade relevance Cyclotron
description:
Decision (Ryan, 2026-10-20): Distinctive (trademark-law publication, repo AnthusAI/Distinctive-web, owner organization account 'Distinctive Mark') uses its own Cyclotron(s) for all screening: publication relevance and section fit. It does not participate in the shared remote Cyclotron used to screen nerdy stuff for Anthus and Data Parade (PPY-3212f1).

Feature: Per-publication Cyclotrons for Distinctive
  Scenario: Distinctive sources are screened only by Distinctive's Cyclotrons
    Given a source discovered for Distinctive
    When relevance and section fit are decided
    Then only Cyclotrons owned by the Distinctive Mark account are consulted
    And no shared Anthus/Data Parade relevance output is created or read for it
  Scenario: Shared screening excludes Distinctive
    Given the shared Anthus/Data Parade relevance Cyclotron
    When it evaluates a discovered source
    Then it produces no Distinctive output and routes nothing to Distinctive
